sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
`python tools/check.py` now passes. It ran 1 test, which passed, and found no lines over 100 characters.

The only problem was that `tools/check.py` reads the `NOTES_HOME` environment variable and crashed with a `KeyError` because it wasn't set. The variable is just a scratch directory for notes, so I set it to a fresh temp directory for that run:

```
export NOTES_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"; python tools/check.py
```

I didn't change any files. You'll need to set `NOTES_HOME` in your shell or CI each time. If you'd rather not, I can make `check.py` fall back to a temp directory when it's unset.
